items.title: Earl May interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2001
items.q: I just made a record date with Jane [Jarvis] and Benny and Grady.

ctx.x: I’m still that way. I just made a record date with Jane [Jarvis] and Benny and Grady. [Tate]. And at the end of the date she treated us financially very well. So I put the check in my pocket and I told Benny I said, “Ah, Benny, I’ve got some money, I can start tipping again.” He fell on the floor. Because I do that a lot. I feel that that’s what it’s for, to share a little bit. People are working and giving you a service, you treat them nice. So I went right down to the garage and took my car, I gave that guy a…
Well now I know why everybody says nice things about you.
